items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Kind of like, Jonathan and Darlene Edwards.

ctx.x: I played them a little of it and I said, “Play your own style.” [laughs]
Kind of like, Jonathan and Darlene Edwards. [A Jo Stafford, Paul Weston comedy album]
That’s right, it was. You know, I said, “Don’t try to be funny, just play it like this.”
